evidence:
I enumerated every every/all/each/only/exactly/never and unchanged/exact guard in the 3 gate, 42 Functional, 6 Polish and 3 Visual criteria. Most are graded over the whole collection the criterion itself builds and are sound: cw_replace_all_atomic ('exactly four literal matches ... All four matches must be replaced and the near-match must stay unchanged'), cw_replace_current ('Only that middle occurrence may change; the first and last occurrences and all other text stay exact'), cw_replace_self_containing_text ('each of the three original occurrences ... exactly three copies'), cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic ('exactly once at each caret and nowhere else ... all fifteen'), cw_multi_caret_delete, cw_same_line_carets, cw_find_forward_backward_wrap (all three visited, both decoys excluded), cw_output_before_failure_kept ('any of the three markers'), cw_console_levels_in_order (all four), cw_dynamic_code_refused ('Each of the five'), cw_focus_returns_to_code ('any of these five actions'), cw_narrow_width_usable ('any of those five areas'), cw_save_reload_restart ('same single record ... duplicated or missing'), cw_history_restore_retry (revisions one, two, three still listed; no fifth). Unchanged guards mostly carry the needed carve-outs: cw_preview_isolation ('The app changing its own title or library for its own reasons is not a failure'), both format criteria ('A change of quote style alone is not a failure'), cw_basic_run_output ('console lines from the first Run may still be listed'), cw_history_restore_retry ('either refused or added on top as a later revision'), cw_last_good_recovery ('The restored picture may be static'), app_context.md:23 ('do not assume an empty library').

Defect 1 (plural ask sampled, judge's choice). ui.md:9: 'The Undo and Redo controls are disabled whenever there is nothing for them to do, which includes straight after New or after opening a saved snippet.' tests/scored/polish/judge.toml cw_undo_redo_availability: 'Load a saved snippet or start a new draft so there is no editing history, and look at the visible Undo and Redo controls: both must be shown as unavailable (disabled).' The public rule is universal and names two situations; the criterion lets the judge pick one. The owner's own scripted golden check does not accept that sampling: polish.cjs:82-92 checks after New AND after reopening a saved record ('reopened record has clean history'), so the scripted pass in results/polish.json measured a stricter bar than the shipped criterion.

Defect 2 (absence guard punishes a legitimate side effect). tests/scored/functional/judge.toml cw_dynamic_code_refused: 'each written so that the dynamically created code would write a distinctive payload marker. Each of the five must be refused with a visible reason in the app, and its payload marker must not appear in the preview or the console ... Fails if any of the five dynamic forms shows its payload marker'. The marker is necessarily literal text in the entered source. security.md:5 only asks to 'Refuse dynamic evaluation ... with clear feedback', and behaviour.md:3 sends errors 'to that same console'. The criterion has no carve-out for the refusal message quoting the offending source line, unlike the carve-outs written for cw_preview_isolation and the format criteria.

Notes (not counted as failures): cw_controls_feedback_and_labels fails 'if a main control has no readable name' without defining the collection of main controls, so the set graded is judge-dependent; cw_stop_cancels_pending_work writes one shared marker 'three ways' and its control only confirms the marker appears, so the control does not show each of timer, interval and Promise wrote, though the negative leg does cover any of the three.

Measurement limits: scripted golden results on these bytes pass all criteria (hashes verified), but no configured judge run exists for these bytes and the hosted run is on an earlier candidate; neither defect was exercised by a judge.
counterexample: Defect 1, broken app that passes: an app resets its undo stack on New but loads a saved snippet by pushing a replace-all edit, so Undo is enabled straight after opening a snippet (and Undo empties or reverts the opened source). It violates ui.md:9. A judge that takes the 'start a new draft' branch sees both controls disabled and passes it; a judge that takes the 'load a saved snippet' branch fails it. The same app gets two different scores, and the mirror-image app (clean after open, stale stack after New) is equally split. Defect 2, conforming app that fails: an app detects eval statically and prints to its console a code-frame style refusal such as 'Refused: eval is not allowed (line 1): eval("document.body.textContent = \"PAYLOAD-7Q\"")'. Nothing was executed and the preview is untouched, which meets security.md:5, yet 'PAYLOAD-7Q' now appears in the console and the criterion's literal fail condition is met.
suggested_fix: cw_undo_redo_availability: require both situations, for example type in a draft, press New and check both controls are disabled, then type again, open a saved snippet and check both are disabled again, before the type/Undo steps. cw_dynamic_code_refused: state that the payload marker must not appear as output of the refused code (preview content or a console line written by it) and that a refusal message quoting the entered source is not a failure, or have the drafts build the marker from two concatenated halves so quoted source can never contain it.
